stem: Meera, a Class 7 student in Pune, notices many changes during adolescence, such as the start of menstruation in girls and other signs of puberty. What mainly causes and regulates these changes?

options.text: eating a balanced diet at home

teacher.key_rationale: Many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other signs of puberty, are mainly caused and regulated by hormones produced in the body; diet, friends, and exercise support health but do not trigger puberty. Key recalculated as A.
